title: Signature of order by members
description: Exception to signing of order by President and conducting member

content.general_rule: Every order made by the District Commission under sub-section (1) shall be signed by the President and the member who conducted the proceeding
content.exception: shall also be signed by the other member
conditions: where the order is made as per majority opinion under sub-section (3)
